chunks: Aban narrated from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about purchasing the slave of Ahl al-Dhimmah. He said: "If they acknowledge that for them, then buy and marry."

key_terms.أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ: non-Muslim protected subjects living under dhimmah
key_terms.شِرَاءِ: purchase or buying in a legal transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy a slave from Ahl al-Dhimmah if they recognize the ownership?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the purchase of an owned slave from Ahl al-Dhimmah. The Imam عليه السلام states that when their recognized ownership is acknowledged among them, the transaction and subsequent marriage are permissible.
